`create_model` can build a model over a subset of the network’s snapshots, storing that subset in `model.parameters.snapshots`. However, `solve_model` passes `n.snapshots` to `_call_extra_functionality`; under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`, the helper leaves that full index unchanged, so the callback receives more snapshots than the model was built over.
